coverage_note: Commonwealth and local public employees under the Public Employe Relations Act (Act 195 of 1970, 43 P.S. 1101.101 et seq.). Police and firefighters bargain under Act 111 of 1968, which this row does not cite. Text is the General Assembly's PDF of Act 195 with compiler's notes; section numbers are Act 195 sections.

governing_statute.value: Public Employe Relations Act, Act of July 23, 1970, P.L. 563, No. 195 (43 P.S. 1101.101 et seq.)
governing_statute.quote: It shall be lawful for public employes to organize, form, join or assist in employe organizations or to engage in lawful concerted activities for the purpose of collective bargaining or other mutual aid and protection

ulp_limitation_period.value: Four months from the acts or statements to the filing of the petition or charge
ulp_limitation_period.quote: No petition or charge shall be entertained which relates to acts which occurred or statements which were made more than four months prior to the filing of the petition or charge.

who_may_bargain.value: Any individual employed by a public employer, except elected officials, gubernatorial appointees confirmed by the Senate, management-level and confidential employees, clergy and religious-facility personnel, and police and firefighters covered by Act 111
who_may_bargain.quote: (2) "Public employe" or "employe" means any individual employed by a public employer but shall not include elected officials, appointees of the Governor with the advice and consent of the Senate as required by law, management level employes, confidential employes

scope_of_bargaining.value: Wages, hours and other terms and conditions of employment; employers need not bargain over matters of inherent managerial policy

impasse_procedure.value: Mandatory mediation through the Bureau of Mediation tied to the budget submission date, then discretionary fact-finding by a board-appointed panel. Voluntary binding arbitration is allowed (advisory where legislation would be needed). Prison and mental hospital guards and court employees go to final and binding arbitration.
impasse_procedure.quote: Upon receiving such notice the board may in its discretion appoint a fact-finding panel which panel may consist of either one or three members.

strike_legality.value: Limited right. After the Article VIII impasse procedures are exhausted, a strike is lawful unless it creates a clear and present danger to public health, safety or welfare. Strikes by prison and mental hospital guards and court employees are prohibited at any time.
strike_legality.quote: If a strike by public employes occurs after the collective bargaining processes set forth in sections 801 and 802 of Article VIII of this act have been completely utilized and exhausted, it shall not be prohibited unless or until such a strike creates a clear and present danger or threat to the health, safety or welfare of the public.

agency_fee_status.value: Not collectible from nonconsenting public employees under Janus v. AFSCME (2018). Act 195 allows maintenance-of-membership clauses (members must keep paying while members); compiler's notes refer to Act 84 of 1988, which was not captured.
agency_fee_status.quote: For these reasons, States and public-sector unions may no longer extract agency fees from nonconsenting employees.
